Create detect-noop-bash.sh hook with classification, per-session counter, threshold message, fail-open behavior
shellcheck clean and manual smoke test verification

approaches_tried.approach: printf '%s' (no trailing newline) piped through tr into a while-read segment loop
approaches_tried.reason: read returns nonzero on the final line when input lacks a trailing newline, so the loop body never executed for the (only) segment -- every command was misclassified as trivial. Fixed by using printf '%s\n' before the tr split.
